args.title: Investigate 0.2.0-waitlist Canary False-Positive Alert Due to Missing Traffic

args.reason: The canary received no traffic (canary traffic=0.000, error_rate=no data), contradicting the headline error rate; investigate routing, service mesh configuration, and pod readiness rather than rolling back.

parts.text: I propose a hold on canary release 0.2.0-waitlist while investigating traffic routing and readiness metrics, as the canary received no traffic to evaluate.
